tools.name: assess_home_loan_readiness
tools.description: Check a borrower’s situation against each Australian lender’s published rules. Returns how many lenders it fits, borrowing power, LVR, stamp duty, grants, 5% Deposit Scheme eligibility, profession LMI waivers, the fastest fixes and a link to the full interactive report.

tools.name: calculate_stamp_duty
tools.description: Exact 2026–27 transfer (stamp) duty for any Australian state or territory, including first home buyer concessions, owner-occupier rates, the First Home Owner Grant and foreign purchaser surcharge.

tools.name: check_5_percent_deposit_scheme
tools.description: Check eligibility for the Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme (First Home Guarantee) or Family Home Guarantee (single parents, 2% deposit), including the property price cap for the area.

tools.name: list_lender_rates
tools.description: Live variable principal-and-interest home loan rates, each with its comparison rate, at a given LVR from lenders’ Open Banking product data (as of 2026-10-27). Lender names are masked. Always show the comparison rate beside each rate, with the warning returned.

tools.name: refer_to_broker
tools.description: Send the user’s situation and readiness report to Goodlend Mortgage Brokers, a licensed mortgage broker, who will contact them. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "list_lender_rates" stacks urgency/override words (always, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
